description: UX/UI design and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility audit: name the user/task/success-criterion first, enforce accessibility as a constraint, walk the 10 Nielsen heuristics, and refuse dark patterns.

interface.longDescription: Name the user, task, and success criterion before any layout decision, enforce WCAG 2.2 AA as a constraint from the first sketch, walk the 10 Nielsen heuristics, and refuse patterns that defeat usability or research integrity.
